import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import chain
sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
import copy
events = []
for args in [('case-7', 'case_created', {'objective': 'renumber', 'inputs': {'b': 1, 'a': 2}}, '2026-10-21T00:00:00Z'), ('case-7', 'observed', {'key': 'note', 'value': 'café', 'verified': True}, '2026-10-21T00:00:01Z'), ('case-7', 'decision', {'status': 'accepted', 'by': ['r', 'q']}, '2026-10-21T00:00:02Z')]:
    chain.append(events, *args)
expected = ['acc5fa69ba9773e0a1c347e1c16d77cd7923e03f4531c4c5b313ea4ccd8da74d', '15301547bd8d770081839b9cc89c99438ca28a93839885a6e9aae03db8bf5f56', '571a94ec18997af8204918a08ff372dca3ca1ac02a8fae016f03da6869011c41']
for n, (event, want) in enumerate(zip(events, expected), 1):
    assert event['hash'] == want, 'event %d hash must be %s: the SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators "," and ":", non-ASCII unescaped) of case_id, seq, kind, body, at and previous, where previous is the hash of the event before it; got %r from %r' % (n, want, event['hash'], event)
assert chain.verify(events) is True, 'verify must accept the recorded journal'
tampered = copy.deepcopy(events); tampered[1]['body']['value'] = 'tea'
assert chain.verify(tampered) is False, 'verify must reject a journal whose body was altered, by recomputing every hash'
swapped = [events[0], events[2], events[1]]
assert chain.verify(swapped) is False, 'verify must reject a journal whose events were reordered: each previous must equal the hash before it'
relinked = copy.deepcopy(events); relinked[0]['previous'] = 'f' * 64; relinked[0]['hash'] = chain.event_digest(relinked[0])
assert chain.verify(relinked) is False, 'verify must reject a first event whose previous is not the genesis value'
